title: Reconcile original P112 cover contracts for three caller rows
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Historical TWOSIDE(6,4):62/69 under six pinned contracts
+ 65/69 under an expanded fixed inventory, recovering three original beta applications
```

The three rows `2^2,3,6,7^6`, `2^2,4,5,7^6` and `2,3^2,5,7^6` have a quotient basis covered by two six-flats and ONE common cut of at most two lines. The original rank-seven beta span bound gives four directions where six independent directions are required. Earlier exclusions retain credit; four inventory-uncertified rows are not a current public unresolved count.

This closes PR3282's omitted-original-contract audit, with a written quotient/characteristic-zero argument, all 69 literal rows, four-rule indexed certificates and fixed source authentication. Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, Nick Petalas/PR3161/3282 and their retained E8/P112 lineage. Exact source heads and verbatim payloads are included. Concurrent Batch5 analytic capacity and mixed-cut40 investigations are distinct and unused.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3282 deliberately omits original alpha/beta cover contracts. After: two implementations agree on all 276 rule/row assignment counts and conditional 65/69 coverage. One remaining caller needs four deleted lines; a control rejects applying the available two-line theorem there.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, eight actual CLI source/receipt controls, five caller controls, Ruff and all 17 committed-byte comparisons pass. The exact committed read-only Git-free export passes all three direct commands under optimized CPython 3.13. A designated internal peer receipt is retained in REVIEW.json.

```sh
python3 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-b6-t4-original-covers
```

Inherited geometric theorems, distance/caps, predecessor heavy censuses and prior six-contract coverage remain conditional and unrun. No actual support-union/coefficient realization, full C5, decoder floor, physical supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Human and proof-kernel review and hosted CI are separate. Open next questions name precise remaining caller boundaries.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only a new research package is added. Archival intake does not admit a supplier or select a frontier.
